findings.title: No verified agent identity observed in MCP configuration
findings.description: Agent 'project:corpus' is configured for network MCP server 'remote-crm', but no proxy/gateway policy governs this agent→MCP edge (no bound_agents restriction). Caller identity enforcement was not observed in the supplied configuration. The server may enforce identity elsewhere; live authorization was not tested.
findings.remediation_guidance: Front the MCP server with the agent-bom gateway/proxy, bind the calling agent via bound_agents, and require a verified agent identity (require_agent_identity / OAuth).

findings.title: AI agent can reach a credential or privileged tool: project:corpus → github → GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (+2 more)
findings.description: An AI agent's tool-use chain reaches a credential or privileged tool node. A compromised or prompt-injected agent could harvest those credentials, turning a single agent into a lateral-movement pivot. Agent project:corpus can reach 3 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).
findings.remediation_guidance: Broker credentials through a short-lived token issuer instead of exposing them to the agent, and scope the agent's tools to the minimum required.

evidence.detail: Agent project:corpus can reach 3 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration DOCKER-002: No USER directive (runs as root)
findings.description: The final build stage sets no USER, so the container runs as root by default. Add a USER directive with a non-root user.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration DOCKER-009: COPY . . without .dockerignore
findings.description: COPY . . copies the entire build context into the image. Without a .dockerignore, secrets, .git, and other sensitive files may be included. Create a .dockerignore file.

findings.description: Image 'ghcr.io/acme/agent-base:latest' is not pinned by digest (sha256). Use @sha256:<hash> to guarantee immutable base images.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration GHA-004: Workflow has no top-level permissions
findings.description: Without a top-level permissions: block the GITHUB_TOKEN gets the repository default, which may be write. Declare least-privilege permissions.

findings.title: AI agent can reach a credential or privileged tool: project:corpus → github → GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (+2 more)
findings.description: An AI agent's tool-use chain reaches a credential or privileged tool node. A compromised or prompt-injected agent could harvest those credentials, turning a single agent into a lateral-movement pivot. Agent project:corpus can reach 3 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).
findings.remediation_guidance: Broker credentials through a short-lived token issuer instead of exposing them to the agent, and scope the agent's tools to the minimum required.

evidence.detail: Agent project:corpus can reach 3 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).
